statement: The intersection of all epimorphism kernels from Fhat_2 to SL2(F5) gives the characteristic quotient SL2(F5)^19 times C2^2, with its exact central reduction to D.38's A5^19. At this named refinement precisely the 5,062,500 cusp-triangle survivors admit normalized multiplier-minus-one f-coordinates satisfying both cycle equations and the involution norm. Each has 64 such coordinates, which induce one actual order-two automorphism for that base tuple. All 2,531,250 survivors outside the finite pure conjugacy set still pass.

notes: All 120 SL2 matrices, perfection, the exact A5 projective isomorphism, all 120 lifted automorphisms and all 76 generating-pair sign lifts are executed.
